```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = T, cache.comments = FALSE,
                      echo = F, include = TRUE, 
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8,
                      fig.pos = 'H',dev = 'png', dpi = 300)

library(tidyverse)
# library(mgcv)
library(brms)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(lme4)

binomial_smooth <- function(...) {
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), ...)
}
```




plotting params

```{r}
sqrt_breaks = c(1,4,9,16,25,36,50,64,81)
breaks <- 10^(-10:10)
minor_breaks <- rep(1:9, 21)*(10^rep(-10:10, each=9))

SEsmooth=F
my_alpha=0.2
bun_limits = c(1,100)
crea_limits = c(10,1000)

mortality_threshold = 0.05
```

## Data

```{r load_data}
sm_data = readr::read_csv(file = 'Data/Analysis_data.csv')
smac = read_csv('Data/smac.csv')
table(hb=is.na(smac$HB), hct=is.na(smac$HCT))
sm_data_analysis = sm_data %>% 
  filter(INCLUDE_CC_ANALYSIS,
         !is.na(Hb)) %>%
  mutate(`Hb<5g/dL`=ifelse(Hb<5,'Yes','No'))

smac = smac %>% 
  mutate(Reason_exclude = case_when(
    is.na(LACTATE) ~ 'No lactate measurement',
    is.na(HB) ~ 'No haemoglobin or haematocrit',
    is.na(Died) ~ 'No outcome',
    T ~ 'INCLUDE'))
table(smac$Reason_exclude)
smac = smac %>% filter(!is.na(Died), !is.na(LACTATE), !(is.na(HB))) %>%
  mutate(Lactate=LACTATE, `Hb<5g/dL`=ifelse(HB<5,'Yes','No'), Hb=HB, Died_28D=Died)
any(is.na(smac$Hb))

aggregate(Died~STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis, FUN = function(x) c(round(100*mean(x)), length(x)))

cols = intersect(colnames(sm_data_analysis), colnames(smac))
dat = rbind(sm_data_analysis[,cols], smac[,cols])
table(dat$STUDY)
dat$STUDY=as.factor(dat$STUDY)
dat$SITEID=as.factor(dat$SITEID)
dat$Age_cat=as.factor(dat$Age<5)
dat$Anaemic= as.factor(dat$`Hb<5g/dL`)
```



## Prognostic models

individual studies

```{r}
dat %>% filter(Lactate<15, Coma_Final==0) %>%
  group_by(STUDY) %>%
  mutate(STUDY = paste0(STUDY, " (n = ", n(), ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate, y = Died_28D))+
  geom_point()+theme_minimal()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+ylab('Proportion dead by day 28')+
  xlab('Lactate (umol/L)')+ 
  geom_smooth(method='gam',method.args = list(family='binomial'))+
  facet_wrap(~STUDY)
```


simple logistic regression

```{r}
mod_lactate = glmer(Died_28D ~ (Lactate>5) + Anaemic + Coma_Final + (1|STUDY/SITEID), family = 'binomial', data = dat)
summary(mod_lactate)
```



brms 

```{r}
## mgcv version
gam_lactate = mgcv::gam(Died ~ s(Lactate, by=Anaemic) +  Anaemic + Coma_Final + s(STUDY, bs='re'),
          data = dat %>% filter(Lactate<15), family = binomial())

dat = dat %>% filter(Lactate<15, Coma_Final==0)
m2_lactate = brm(bf(Died ~ s(Lactate, by=Anaemic,k=4)+Anaemic+(1|STUDY/SITEID)),
          data = dat , 
          family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
          iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, thin = 10, refresh = 250)
dat$M2_preds=fitted(m2_lactate,re_formula = NA)[, 'Estimate']
dat %>% ggplot(aes(x=Lactate, y = M2_preds, colour = Anaemic))+  geom_jitter()
```


```{r lactate_prognostic_models, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

h1=smac%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate, color=`Hb<5g/dL`))+
  geom_density()+theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis label
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"), legend.position = "none")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,13))+ggtitle(label = paste('SMAC (n=',nrow(smac),')',sep = ''))
p1=smac%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate,y=Died, color=`Hb<5g/dL`))+
  binomial_smooth()+theme_minimal()+
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"), legend.position = "none")+
  ylab('Probability of death')+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0, .2), xlim = c(0,13))

h2=sm_data%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate, color=`Hb<5g/dL`))+
  geom_density()+theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis label
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"), legend.position = "none")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,13))+ggtitle(label = paste('Pooled severe malaria studies (n=',nrow(sm_data),')',sep = ''))

p2=sm_data%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate,y=Died, color=`Hb<5g/dL`))+
  binomial_smooth()+theme_minimal()+
   theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"), legend.position = "none")+
 ylab('Probability of death')+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0, .2), xlim = c(0,13))
grid.arrange(h1, h2, p1,p2,nrow=2, ncol = 2, heights = c(1, 1.2))


mod = gam(Died~ s(Lactate, by = as.numeric(Hb<5)) + s(STUDY, bs='re') + Coma_Final,
          family = 'binomial',data = dat)
summary(mod)
```
